prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 12 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text:
A vertical 9:16 phone video, 12 seconds, one continuous handheld take with no cuts, photorealistic like a real funny fail clip filmed by a friend on the riverbank. A calm, wide green river on a warm, hazy late afternoon. A thin, slanted tree trunk with pale grey bark leans out from the bank over the water, leafy branches and tall grass on the far bank behind. The camera stands on the bank a little above and films from the front: the whole crouched body and the trunk under the feet in view, the face big and sharp.

The person = the person in [Image 1], in EVERY frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1]: face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo. The same real person from the first frame to the last, so their friends recognize them at once, also while they swing the hatchet and while they fall. Never morph. The person wears the clothes from [Image 1]; if [Image 1] shows only the upper body, add simple casual shorts and bare feet so it matches naturally. No logos, emblems or text on the clothes. If [Image 1] shows an animal, that animal does all of this with its own face, fur and markings and the natural body volume and proportions of that animal, holding the hatchet in its front paws.

Shot 1 [0-9.8s]: the person crouches in a deep squat on top of the thin slanted trunk out over the river, bare feet or shoes gripping the bark, and chops with a small wood-handled hatchet at the trunk right between their own feet and the bank, the part that holds them up. Steady one-handed chops, the free hand on the wood for balance; near the end two big two-handed swings over the head. Wood chips fly and the pale cut in the trunk grows deeper. A focused, determined face, a quick proud glance at the camera between chops, no idea what comes next.
Shot 2 [9.8-10.8s]: one last swing: with a loud crack the trunk snaps at the cut, and the person and the top of the trunk drop straight down toward the water; the camera tilts down after them, the face shocked, the mouth open.
Shot 3 [10.8-12s]: a huge white splash in the green river beside the leaves at the bank; the hatchet and the broken piece of trunk splash in too, and the water ripples. The video ends on the splash.

A harmless slapstick fall into calm, deep water: no injury, no blood, no rocks.

Audio: only the real sounds of the scene: the dull thock of the hatchet biting the wood on each chop, birds and a soft river, a sharp loud crack, a short wordless yelp, a big splash, then friends laughing off camera. No dialogue throughout the entire video. No background music.

No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark. Exactly one person, no other people on screen. One head, two arms, two hands with five fingers each, two legs. One hatchet.
